title: The Confidence *Interval*
dek: AI's price, geography, and legal categories all tried to hold firm this week. None of them did.

stories.label: Nasdaq fell Nov 5, worst single-day drop in 19 months
stories.headline: The valuation premise is under test; that's different from the company being under test.
The company going public uses its largest competitor's balance sheet as a floor.

stories.label: non-Chinese customer floor Nvidia requires of cloud providers
stories.headline: Export controls restrict chip sales; Moonshot just showed access can be rented around ownership.
The company that closes the gap between capability and efficiency wins the enterprise layer.

stories.label: per hour for Tau Robotics' human-guided humanoid cleaning service
stories.headline: The showcase is Western. The scale is not. 95% of H1 humanoid shipments came from China.
State AI content and humanoid robotics converge on one surface: a face that broadcasts.

stories.short: DOJ task force, no defined crime
stories.headline: The enforcement mandate exists. The defined offense does not. That is the gap to watch.

still_signal: Three tried to put a boundary on AI this week: a price, a geography, a legal category. All found it more porous than designed. The efficiency race and humanoid shipment data measure the same gap from a different direction.
